create_tfrecord_dataloader: create a TFRecordDataLoader to load BERT TFRecords with configurable batch size and sequence length
use_record2example_parser: use Record2Example to decode a BERT TF record into a parsed TF example with int32 types
convert_tf_to_torch: convert a TensorFlow example dict to PyTorch tensors with mask and label arrays for masked language modeling
use_multiprocess_loader: use MultiprocessLoader to iterate over a TensorFlow dataloader in a background thread with a bounded queue
iterate_tfrecord_dataloader: iterate over a TFRecordDataLoader to yield batches of PyTorch tensors for BERT training or evaluation
